summary: Comprehensive testing of FitJourney auth flow and patient creation fixes. All critical bugs confirmed FIXED: (1) Admin login works with credentials wylkem.nutri.ufpa@gmail.com / Admin123!, (2) Patient creation via POST /api/admin/patients/create accepts password field and creates auth user with that password, (3) Patient login with form-provided password works, (4) Select component in dialog does NOT close dialog when selecting gender (position=popper fix working).

minor.issue: patient_subscriptions insert fails with 'null value in column package_type' - subscription creation is best-effort but should have default value

issues: Form is quite long - consider collapsible sections for optional fields

passed_tests: Admin login via Supabase Auth API (POST /auth/v1/token?grant_type=password) - 200 OK
Patient creation with custom password returns password_set: true
Patient creation without password returns password_set: false
Patient creation with short password (<6 chars) returns password_set: false
Patient login with form-provided password works via Supabase Auth
Frontend loads correctly with FitJourney branding
Admin login flow works (Entrar como Administrador button)
CRITICAL: Select component (gender) does NOT close dialog after selection (position=popper fix verified)
critical_code_review_comments: admin_patients.py line 267-271: patient_subscriptions INSERT fails because package_type is required but not provided. Consider adding default value 'mensal' in the backend code.
Code quality is good - password handling logic at line 144 correctly validates min 6 chars
seed_data_creation: Test patients created during pytest with unique emails (paciente.test.*, paciente.nopass.*, paciente.short.*)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All auth and patient creation flows are working. Backend uses Supabase Auth directly (NOT /api/auth/login). Patient password is passed to backend via 'password' field in POST /api/admin/patients/create. Select components use position='popper' to prevent closing dialogs. Minor issue: patient_subscriptions table requires package_type but backend doesn't provide default.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause was: (1) Backend was ignoring form password and generating random one - FIXED by using request.password when >=6 chars; (2) Select component used default position='item-aligned' which caused dialog to close - FIXED by setting position='popper' on SelectContent
